subject: Evidence pack request: dedicated region assertions, isolation diagrams, and archival retention
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@novabank.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@novabank.com
Date: Sun, 4 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: physical/logical isolation proof + archival retention timeline (Dedicated)

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the demo last week. Legal and infra need a short evidence pack before we can move our dedicated deployment to a contract signature:

- Confirmation that the tenant will be pinned to a single EU region and the mechanism (pinning policy + rollback behavior)
- Diagram showing physical rack/network isolation for dedicated pools (tenant boundary and host tenancy)
- Retention matrix for primary/backup/snapshot copies and the guaranteed erase timeline once tenancy is terminated
- Statement on whether cold snapshots are replicated outside the EU and if so how we control or disable that replication

Can you send this as a single package or point us to a secure link? Ideally we need something our auditors can sign off on by EOD Wednesday.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looping in legal for any contractual language questions.

Best,
Alice
Alice Nguyen
Head of Cloud Security, NovaBank
legal@novabank.com

Attachments: none

From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@novabank.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 5 Aug 2029 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: physical/logical isolation proof + archival retention timeline (Dedicated)

Alice — thanks for the clear list. We've pulled together an evidence bundle and a short explainer. High level answers below; full artifacts attached and a secure Drive link included.

1) Region pinning: we provide a tenant-level region_pin property at provisioning. When set to eu-west-1 (example), all active compute and persistent volumes for that tenant are scheduled into that region. We include a config extract and runtime routing policy in the diagram (attached). Rollback behavior: if a pin request is changed we trigger an evacuation workflow that streams KV cache off and drains in-region; manual approval is required for cross-region moves.

2) Physical/logical isolation: attached is a network and host tenancy diagram showing dedicated GPU pools, tenant VLAN segmentation, and per-tenant keystore boundaries. For Dedicated customers we reserve host nodes to the tenant pool; we do not colocate unassociated customers on the same reserved hosts.

3) Retention & erase: the retention_matrix_v2.csv shows retention windows for primary tokens, model caches, backups and snapshots. Key points:
   - Active workspace data: retained while subscription active; immediate suspend on termination followed by a 30-day soft-hold (customer recoverable)
   - Cold snapshots: retained for 90 days by default unless contract states otherwise; snapshots are logically bound to the tenant and flagged for deletion after the hold period
   - Backup replication: we do not replicate tenant snapshots outside the pinned region by default for Dedicated plans. Cross-region replication only occurs if explicitly enabled via a DR add-on; policy requires customer opt-in.

4) Evidence and verification: also attached is a playbook describing the tenant wipe workflow, forensic validation steps we run (hashing, snapshot manifests), and timestamps we log to the audit trail. We can provide a signed attestation after a dry-run wipe if that helps.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/novabank-regionproof
Attachments: redwood_region_pin_diagram.pdf, retention_matrix_v2.csv, snapshot_wipe_playbook.docx

Next steps: Karthik will confirm the mapping to our provisioning API and estimate time for a dry-run wipe. Marissa, can you validate the wording for the attestation and produce a one-page auditor-friendly statement?

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Account Lead — Enterprise, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 6 Aug 2029 08:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: physical/logical isolation proof + archival retention timeline (Dedicated)

Looping in ops: quick technical notes to include in the packet before we hand to NovaBank auditors.

- Provisioning API: we will attach the exact API response snippet for region_pin and node_assignment. Example included in Drive under /api-examples.
- Snapshot replication flag: default is false for Dedicated. If legal requires an explicit contractual guarantee we can mark replication as disallowed in the onboarding policy and add a service indicator to the SLA.
- Wipe proof: ops will run a PSK-signed manifest after wipe; we keep manifests in the customer audit log for 12 months and can export a notarized hash list.

Marissa — can you draft the auditor statement covering: region pin guarantee, replication default, and wipe manifest retention? Keep it single page and avoid internal implementation specifics.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@novabank.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@novabank.com
Date: Tue, 6 Aug 2029 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: physical/logical isolation proof + archival retention timeline (Dedicated)

Olga + team — thanks, this is exactly what we needed. I reviewed the Drive artifacts and retention matrix. Two quick clarifications before we pass to audit:

1) On the 30-day soft-hold for active workspace data — can you confirm whether NovaBank (customer) has an API or console control to shorten that hold to 0 days at termination, or is that only achievable via a contract override?
2) For the notarized wipe manifests — can those be generated on-demand for any historical wipe within the 12-month log window, or do you need a retention request to pull archived manifests?

If you can answer those two items in a short reply we'll route to audit. We may also take you up on the dry-run and attestation next week.

Best,
Alice
Head of Cloud Security, NovaBank
